verdict.rationale: Sill is a remote-display app that streams a Mac's windows or desktop to an iPhone or iPad for touch, keyboard and Pencil control. It has no AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client and use tools, so plugging in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Sill shipping any MCP or agent capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
